findings: Audio is Mummy's Riches' bank unchanged: 52 of 53 sprite regions at byte-identical offsets/lengths, normalised RMS envelopes identical across all 52 (mean level ratio 0.9513, a re-encode). build/assets/audio/sounds.json 'source' names bgm_main as 'BASE GAME MUSIC - Percussive Ancient Egypt Ambience Theme'. src/game/soundCatalogue.ts:101-104 states it: 'still Mummy's Riches' audio until the sound pass replaces it'. 10.5 MB, 23% of the 45 MB build.
Twelve shipped cues (sfx_mummy_roar x4, sfx_mummy_step x2, sfx_door_drag, sfx_wall_smash, sfx_sword_swing, sfx_superfreespin) are for mummy mechanics deleted 2026-09-02 and are never requested.
bgm_burst, the only cue authored for this game, decodes to peak 1.0291 (above 0 dBFS); compensated with sprite volume 0.55 rather than remastered (sounds.json config, soundCatalogue.ts:32).

FREE SPINS buy card and rules table print MAX WIN 10,000x (src/game/config.ts:156; MenuModal.svelte:264,294,699) while the shipped pack caps that mode at 5,000x (math-sdk/games/wild_wanted/library/publish_files/lookUpTable_bonus_0.csv max payout 500000/100; library/stats_summary.json bonus.max_win 500000.0). tools/verify_maxwin_sync.mjs PASSes because it compares config.ts to game_config.py, never the simulated pack. MenuModal.svelte:249-250 carries the correct fact in a comment.

Rules table prints RTP 96.0% on every mode (config.ts:30,141,148,155,177,195,206 rtp: 0.96; MenuModal.svelte:283). All six shipped lookUpTable_*_0.csv measure 96.50%; stats_summary.json reports 0.965. Displayed does not equal actual.

Identity stops at the reels. The control bar, the menu sheet and the entire BONUS BUY panel are stock SDK navy/charcoal with royal-blue buttons, un-themed, on a warm cartoon Wild West game (screenshots z-jpy-buy.png, v3-menu.png, ses2-spin09.png). The buy panel is the 250x purchase surface and carries nothing of the game.

BIG WIN tier starts at 15x on a 10,000x game (src/game/winLevelMap.ts:83-84). Observed a full-screen plaque, coin shower and press-to-continue gate for $24.00 on a $1.00 bet, first spin of a forced free-spins round. HUD read WIN $0.00 while the plaque read $24.00 during the presentation.

?lang=de leaves the three intro-card descriptions and PLAY in English while the titles translate; those three strings are absent from src/i18n/messagesMap/de.ts (grep count 0). The same file still carries copy for cut mechanics ('The Brute slams the floor...', 'EXPANDING WILD') which ships in the production bundle.

Handlers for deleted mechanics ship in the PRODUCTION bundle: mummySmash, mummyNudge, mummyWildLevelUp, pyramidDescend, wildExpand, bombDetonate in bookEventHandlerMap. math-sdk/games/wild_wanted/readme.txt:44 confirms it is deliberate and names the risk: a stray event 'REPLAYS, animating a mechanic the maths never ran'.

26.8 MiB and 230 requests before the PLAY button enables on the production build served locally (71.9 s in a no-GPU container; the byte figure is hardware-independent, the seconds are not). Build is 45 MB / 422 files; both mp3 (5.83 MB) and ogg (4.66 MB) audio sprites ship, assets/rig is 15 MB across three near-identical outlaw Spriter rigs.

Requests do not plateau on a 60 s idle park: 209 to 326. Every one of the 117 is a distinct asset requested once, so it is a lazy-preload tail rather than per-frame request churn, but the game is still downloading itself past 80 seconds.

22 assets byte-identical to Mummy's Riches. Fonts, licences, studio loader mark and SDK glyphs are fair; symbols/wild_cell_bg.webp, symbols/connect_wild_frame.webp, symbols/connect_wild_plaque.webp, win/mountain_of_coins.webp, frame/tile-dark.webp, coins/coin.png and the whole spines/anticipation set are the donor game's art.

The committed build/ at 287fca0 is a --mode preview build carrying a live fetch-monkeypatching mock RGS, force hooks and the debug panel. Not a blocker: I ran tools/build_production.mjs and verified rgsMock, previewBooks, devMock, wwForce, DebugPanel, 'POSITION DEBUG', __WW_AUDIT__ and __PIXI_APP__ are all absent from the production artefact, and verify_stake_clean.mjs PASSes. But the artefact in the repo is not the one you would send.
Buy CTA is a cat paw (src/game/assets.ts:226-234) - a studio mark, and the one element on screen with no Wild West vocabulary.
At 1280x720 the outlaw's arm and the SALOON/BANK signage are clipped by the viewport edges (ses2-spin09.png).

GOOD: all six modes at exactly 96.50% RTP; base hit rate 1-in-5.27, boost 1-in-4.52; 10,000x reachable at 1-in-7,964,000 in superbonus; mode costs 1/3/30/60/100/250 match the buy cards and rules exactly.

GOOD: no balance capping of bet levels (stateBet.svelte.ts:51-53); affordability is bet x costMultiplier <= balance (BonusCards.svelte:43-44); buy button stays live on a shortfall and opens a dialog (:50-51,61); resume gated on round.active === true (Authenticate.svelte:34); balance/bet floored to exactly 2 dp in every currency, wins 2-4 dp floored, never rounded up (utils-shared/amount.ts:90-99), confirmed live at ?ccy=JPY.

GOOD: ?social=true rewrites 'pays a multiplier of your bet' to 'wins a multiplier of your spin' with zero banned tokens in rendered output; ?social=true&lang=de renders English; ?lang=zzinvalid loads English with zero console errors; scrub table covers inflected forms, not just lemmas.

GOOD: the Mummy's Riches win-beat capping defect is genuinely fixed - the cap is derived per winning symbol via winBeatMsFor, verify_win_beat_cap.mjs PASSes. Turbo tiers three ways on turboLevel, not a boolean.

GOOD: production build from a sub-path returns zero 4xx/5xx; zero external origins; no spaces or capitals under assets/; page never scrolls at 1280x720, 414x896 or 400x225; zero console errors and zero uncaught exceptions across every run.
lift: Cut a Wild West sound pack and delete the twelve mummy regions from the sprite. The base bed, the five reel stops and the win ladder are what a reviewer hears for nine minutes of a ten-minute session, and right now they hear Egypt. Everything else is already at the level I would score a notch higher; the audio is the only thing keeping this at 'waiting on a pass'.
